name: Mech Garage
description: Design and build your own mech in a high-tech garage. Name your robot helper, then talk to it: it fetches parts, holds them while you line them up, and welds them on.
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (built into Windows 11)
Android 8.0 or newer, with OpenGL ES 3 and an up-to-date Android System WebView (from the Play Store)
A microphone to talk to the robot helper (you can type instead)
